roots.inline: The libraries explicitly enable -Winline. Qore Debug uses -Og, at which GCC declines the recorded optional inline expansions. Release -O3 emits none of these warnings.
roots.ngtcp2_rob.c:113: r is assigned whenever d is obtained from the iterator; the other branch sets d=NULL, so the short-circuit expression cannot read r. Both paths initialize r before the later range end read; allocation or insertion failure returns first.
roots.ngtcp2_acktr.c:258: The loop assigns ent before any break; zero iterations or exhausting the entries returns when j==nacks before any use of ent.
roots.compiler_reproduction: Recompiling the unchanged real ngtcp2_rob.c and ngtcp2_acktr.c with the recorded Debug flags reproduces both maybe-uninitialized sites and missed-inlining diagnostics; replacing only -Og with -O3 emits zero warnings. This comparison is a control, not a proposed flag change.

limitations: Upstream suites use their normal forked harness; children retain the harness test-name buffer as reachable, while both parent processes free all allocations. No lost allocations or Valgrind errors in any process.
Functional tests do not prove all input paths; the initialization findings additionally rely on source control-flow review.
